The mapped place lies in the Gachibowli/Nanakramguda Financial District area of west Hyderabad, about 5.9 km west-south-west of the ITPH campus in HITEC City and away from the registered office in Madhapur, so it marks DC2 or DC3; the link follows the page's DC3 tour and DC3 resilience sections, but the page does not say which facility it marks. Esri World Imagery (captured 22 October 2026) shows the point on a large multi-storey building with dense rooftop plant beside a second plant-heavy building about 100 m to the south-east. The viewport centre @17.4228236,78.3274561 (316 m west) and the head-office address are not used.
